laws.t: Immigration and Refugee Protection Regulations, ss. 209.2-209.3 (employer conditions)
laws.tp: Employers must not charge recruitment fees and must provide working conditions as offered.
laws.s2: Majikan tidak boleh memungut biaya rekrutmen dan wajib memberi syarat kerja sesuai tawaran.

dec.n: Singh v. Minister of Employment and Immigration
dec.pe: Sikh refugee claimants were refused without ever being heard in person. The Supreme Court said everyone in Canada has the right to life, liberty and security, and they must get a hearing.
dec.pi: Pemohon status pengungsi Sikh ditolak tanpa pernah didengar langsung. MA menyatakan setiap orang di Kanada berhak atas hidup, kebebasan, dan keamanan, dan mereka harus disidangkan.

dec.n: Andrews v. Law Society of British Columbia
dec.pe: A British lawyer living permanently in Canada was barred from practising law because he was not a citizen. The Supreme Court said this was discrimination.
dec.pi: Seorang pengacara Inggris yang tinggal tetap di Kanada dilarang berpraktik karena bukan warga negara. MA menyatakan ini diskriminasi.

dec.n: Baker v. Canada (Minister of Citizenship and Immigration)
dec.pe: A Jamaican woman who had worked for years as a live-in domestic worker faced deportation, leaving behind her four Canadian-born children. The Supreme Court said officials must take the children’s interests seriously.
dec.pi: Seorang perempuan Jamaika yang bertahun-tahun menjadi pekerja rumah tangga tinggal di rumah majikan akan dideportasi, meninggalkan empat anaknya yang lahir di Kanada. MA menyatakan pejabat wajib serius menimbang kepentingan anak-anak.

dec.pe: Ontario farm workers, many of them seasonal migrants, had no legal protection to form unions. The Supreme Court said total exclusion was unconstitutional.
dec.pi: Pekerja pertanian Ontario, banyak di antaranya migran musiman, tidak punya perlindungan hukum untuk membentuk serikat. MA menyatakan pengecualian total itu inkonstitusional.

dec.n: Suresh v. Canada (Minister of Citizenship and Immigration)
dec.pe: A Sri Lankan refugee was ordered deported as a security risk although he might be tortured. The Supreme Court said this would generally be unconstitutional and sent the case back.
dec.pi: Seorang pengungsi Sri Lanka diperintahkan dideportasi sebagai risiko keamanan meski bisa disiksa. MA menyatakan ini umumnya inkonstitusional dan mengembalikan perkaranya.

dec.pe: Non-citizens were held for years on secret evidence they could not see. The Supreme Court struck down the procedure and required prompt reviews of detention.
dec.pi: Bukan warga negara ditahan bertahun-tahun berdasarkan bukti rahasia yang tidak bisa mereka lihat. MA membatalkan prosedur itu dan mewajibkan peninjauan penahanan yang cepat.

dec.pe: After Dunmore, Ontario passed a law letting farm workers form associations but not bargain collectively like other workers. The Supreme Court upheld it.
dec.pi: Setelah Dunmore, Ontario membuat UU yang membolehkan pekerja pertanian membentuk perkumpulan tetapi tidak berunding bersama seperti pekerja lain. MA mempertahankan UU itu.

dec.pe: A woman from Grenada without status in Canada was refused health coverage while seriously ill. The Canadian courts rejected her claim. The UN Human Rights Committee later found Canada in breach.
dec.pi: Seorang perempuan dari Grenada tanpa status di Kanada ditolak jaminan kesehatan saat sakit parah. Pengadilan Kanada menolak gugatannya. Komite HAM PBB kemudian menyatakan Kanada melanggar.

dec.pe: A Tamil teenager who fled Sri Lanka asked to stay on humanitarian grounds and was refused. The Supreme Court said officials had looked at his case too narrowly.
dec.pi: Seorang remaja Tamil yang melarikan diri dari Sri Lanka meminta tetap tinggal atas alasan kemanusiaan dan ditolak. MA menyatakan pejabat memeriksa perkaranya terlalu sempit.

dec.pe: A woman from Grenada living in Canada without status was refused health coverage when she was seriously ill. The UN Human Rights Committee said this put her life at risk and broke the treaty.
dec.pi: Seorang perempuan dari Grenada yang tinggal di Kanada tanpa status ditolak jaminan kesehatan saat sakit parah. Komite HAM PBB menyatakan ini membahayakan nyawanya dan melanggar perjanjian.

dec.n: Canadian Council for Refugees v. Canada (Safe Third Country Agreement)
dec.pe: People turned back at the US border argued they faced detention and refoulement in the US. The Supreme Court upheld the scheme for now but sent the gender-discrimination argument back.
dec.pi: Orang yang ditolak di perbatasan AS berpendapat mereka akan ditahan dan dipulangkan di AS. MA mempertahankan skema itu untuk sementara tetapi mengembalikan argumen diskriminasi gender.
